title: Black Sabbath
studio_context: Regent Sound, Denmark Street, London, 17 November 1969, in one twelve-hour session, the band playing live with almost no overdubs (Evil Woman and Wicked World at Trident, 10 November).

drum_performances.name: Bill Ward
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The first heavy metal record, played live in a day: the title song's tritone riff in slow triplets, crash, kick and snare together on the riff's notes, the verses on the toms alone, and a fast ending in triplets on the ride; N.I.B.'s snare on 2, 3 and 4 every other bar.

notable_moments.description: On the title song: 'I was playing drums to the words', once Ozzy Osbourne sang them.
